units.pet_policy: Cats allowed, maximum of two. Pet deposit $250, plus $25 per month per cat. No dogs.
units.assistance_animal_notice: Service animals and emotional support animals are not pets. They are permitted regardless of the policy above, with no pet deposit and no monthly pet fee. Reasonable documentation may be requested where the law allows.
units.uniform_application_notice: These are the standards for this home. Every applicant is held to the same standards. If you do not meet them, you will not be approved.
units.measurement_notice: Square footage from a CubiCasa floor plan. Measurements deemed reliable but not guaranteed.
units.showing_notice: Email to arrange a time. When a unit is newly listed I run a group showing so everyone sees it on the same day; otherwise we find a time that works. There is no fee and no application required to view the unit — you apply after you have seen it.
units.move_in_funds_notice: Due at move-in by cashier's check or money order. Where a housing authority pays part of the rent, the authority pays its portion directly, on its own schedule; this applies to the tenant's portion only.
units.move_in_total: $4,500 — first month's rent $1,500 plus security deposit $3,000
features: New luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout
Newly tiled shower with glass block window for natural light and privacy
Smart lock and Ring doorbell camera
units.nearby: Mount Mary University 0.8 mi · Mayfair Mall 1.3 mi · Froedtert Hospital 2.8 mi · Milwaukee County Zoo 3.5 mi
quals: Applicant(s) must have current photo identification and a valid Social Security number.

Monthly household income must exceed three times the rent, from verifiable sources. Unverifiable income will not be considered. Housing Choice Vouchers and other lawful sources of income are accepted; where a voucher covers part of the rent, the three-times standard applies only to the portion the tenant pays.
Applicant(s) must receive positive references from all landlords for the previous five years.
Applicant(s) may not have any evictions or unpaid judgments from a previous landlord.
Credit score must be a minimum of 600.

A background check is run on every applicant over 18. We consider convictions within the past seven years that relate to the safety of residents or property. Arrests that did not lead to a conviction are not considered. Applicants may submit evidence of rehabilitation or mitigating circumstances, which we review individually.
Occupancy is limited to two people per bedroom.
